title: 中国早餐宇宙③广州肠粉：薄如纸、白如雪，一匹白绸缎 | Guangzhou Cheung Fun 🥢
description:
你爱斋肠，还是牛肉肠？评论区站队。

【中国早餐宇宙·第3集 广州】薄如纸、白如雪，广州人把它比作「一匹白绸缎」——这就是肠粉。一勺米浆浇上蒸盘，几十秒蒸成一层薄绸，刮起、卷好、淋上豉油。它的起源众说纷纭，一说抗战年间由西关泮塘荷仙馆创制：没有馅的叫「斋肠」，后来才加进虾仁、牛肉。两大流派：布拉肠用白布拉出，主要尝馅；抽屉肠用纯米浆，主要尝粉质与酱汁。一碟肠粉，是广式早茶的头牌；点单配一句「唔该」，走时说一声「得闲饮茶」。

Thin as paper and white as snow, Guangzhou's cheung fun is likened to "a bolt of white silk." A ladle of rice batter hits a steaming tray, sets into a silk sheet in seconds, then gets scraped, rolled and drizzled with soy. Its origin is debated — one account credits Xiguan Poon Tong's Ho Sin Koon in the war years; plain rolls are "jaai cheung," fillings like shrimp and beef came later. Two schools: cloth-pulled (tasted for filling) and drawer-steamed (tasted for texture). It's the star of Cantonese morning tea — order with a soft "m goi," leave with a "yum cha soon."

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run (origin noted as disputed); sources below. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
